note: Literature review indicates optic atrophy is present in approximately 89% of reported cases and sensorineural hearing loss is a hallmark feature across cohorts.

evidence.text: A literature review of 47 reported patients with FDXR-related disorder found optic atrophy in 89% of patients, with sensorineural hearing loss identified as a common neurological manifestation.

source.title: Ocular and neurological manifestations of the FDXR-related disorder
source.quote: Including our case, a total of 47 patients have been reported... Optic atrophy is the most common feature (89%)... Common neurological symptoms include movement disorder, sensorineural hearing loss, developmental delay/regression, and hypotonia.

evidence.text: FDXR deficiency is characteristically defined by sensorial neuropathies presenting as optic atrophy and acoustic neuropathy / hearing loss.

source.title: Expanding the clinical and genetic spectrum of FDXR deficiency by functional validation of variants of uncertain significance
source.quote: Ferrodoxin reductase (FDXR) deficiency is a mitochondrial disease described in recent years primarily in association with optic atrophy, acoustic neuropathy, and developmental delays.
